Superaster local alpha

  superaster inspect INPUT
  superaster remove INPUT --output cutout.png [--quality quality|fast] [--engine ID] [--model-dir DIR] [--overwrite]
  superaster run RECIPE.json --input INPUT --output OUTPUT [--bind reference=PATH] [--model-dir DIR] [--overwrite]
  superaster batch INPUT_DIR --recipe RECIPE.json --output OUTPUT_DIR [--bind reference=PATH] [--model-dir DIR] [--resume|--retry]
  superaster models list
  superaster models install ID [--model-dir DIR]
  superaster capabilities --json
  superaster validate INPUT --preset ID [--preset-version VERSION]
  superaster resolve REQUEST [--preset-version VERSION]
  superaster mcp --roots DIR[,DIR] [--model-dir DIR]

Models are separate verified downloads. Images stay local; outputs do not overwrite existing files unless --overwrite is explicit. JSON uses stdout; progress uses stderr.
